name: lz4_flex (pure-Rust LZ4)
baseline: lz4 1.9.3 C library through the lzzz bindings, block format
verdict_reason: With unsafe features enabled it roughly matches the C library: 10% faster compression on small JSON, 7% faster on dickens, and decompression within 4% either way. The default safe build is 13% to 20% slower than C.
tier_reason: Public criterion benchmark in the repository, with CPU, OS and rustc version stated.
claimed_speedup: Unsafe build vs lz4 1.9.3: 66Kb JSON compress 1615 vs 1469 MiB/s (1.10x), decompress 5512 vs 5313 MiB/s (1.04x); 10 Mb dickens compress 347 vs 324 MiB/s (1.07x), decompress 2734 vs 2759 MiB/s (0.99x). Default safe build: 1272 / 4540 MiB/s on JSON and 259 / 2338 MiB/s on dickens, slower than C (ratios derived from page data).
workload: Block-format compress and decompress of a 66 KB JSON file and the 10 MB dickens text file.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 5900HX, CPU boost disabled, performance governor
platforms: Any Rust target including 32-bit; no_std with the block format
one_liner: Pure-Rust LZ4 that matches the C library when unsafe features are on; the default safe build is up to 20% slower than C.
how_it_is_fast: A from-scratch port of the LZ4 block and frame formats with a hash-table match finder and wide copies. Disabling the safe-encode and safe-decode features swaps bounds-checked slice access for unchecked pointer reads and writes, which is where it catches up with C.
use_it_when: You want LZ4 without a C toolchain (wasm, cross-compiling, no_std)
You can enable the unsafe features for trusted input and want C-level speed
skip_it_when: You need LZ4 HC high-compression modes, which lz4_flex does not implement
You expect it to beat the C library: with defaults it is slower
caveats: Results are for v0.11.0 (2023) on rustc 1.69; the crate is now at 0.14.0
Two input files; the full criterion results are published only as SVG charts
tradeoffs: The fast configuration turns off bounds-checked decoding, which matters for untrusted input

evidence.quote: AMD Ryzen 7 5900HX, rustc 1.69.0 (84c898d65 2023-04-16), Manjaro, CPU Boost Disabled, CPU Governor: Performance
